title: Customer journey map
subtitle: Party and event hire (kids' parties, marquees, cocktail bars). Persona: a parent or host in Borehamwood/North London planning a celebration, booking from a phone and weighing 3-5 local suppliers. Current state shown for Moments and Memories (audit 13 Oct 2026).
source_note: [A] observed in our audit of the live site  [R] from web research  [H] hypothesis to validate with Lisa's enquiry data, customer calls or a short survey. The feeling curve is a judgement, not measured data.

emotion.callout: Biggest drop-off risk: compare and enquire

stages.name: 1 Trigger
stages.label: Something to celebrate
stages.does: A birthday, engagement, wedding or milestone is coming. Needs a date and a rough plan.
stages.touchpoints: Family chat, social media, friends' parties
stages.pain: Overwhelmed by everything to arrange; not sure where to start. [H]
stages.opportunity: Inspiration content (real events, ideas). Referral from past clients. [R: bookings often come from recommendations]

stages.name: 2 Research
stages.label: Search and ask around
stages.does: Googles "bouncy castle / marquee / cocktail bar hire + area", checks Maps, asks Facebook groups and friends.
stages.touchpoints: Google Search and Maps, Facebook/Instagram, word of mouth, directories like Add to Event [R]
stages.pain: Moments and Memories title is only the domain, no meta descriptions, no H1, no local markup or Google Business Profile found (M-01 to M-04). [A]
stages.opportunity: Service + area page titles, Google Business Profile, one page per service, local landing pages.

stages.name: 3 Compare
stages.label: Shortlist 3-5 suppliers
stages.does: Opens several sites on a phone. Looks for real photos, reviews, prices, insurance and safety.
stages.touchpoints: Supplier websites, Google reviews, Facebook pages
stages.pain: Moments and Memories: screenshot/stock images, no reviews, no prices, no safety or insurance info, sideways scroll on mobile, 2.58:1 contrast (M-06 to M-08, M-14). [A]
stages.opportunity: Real event gallery, 5-10 reviews, "from £" packages, insurance/safety block, mobile fixes.

stages.name: 4 Enquire
stages.label: Ask: is my date free, and how much?
stages.does: Wants a fast answer. Taps to call or message, or fills a form with date, place and guests.
stages.pain: Moments and Memories: phone and email are plain text, form has no date/type/place fields, 180-char cap, "Submit", no confirmation (M-05). [A] Quotes depend on date, place, guests, access [R]
stages.opportunity: Sticky Call + WhatsApp bar, quote form with date/type/postcode, thank-you page, track every enquiry.

stages.name: 5 Quote
stages.label: Compare quotes and decide
stages.does: Gets replies from a few suppliers. Checks what is included, delivery, deposit and who answered first.
stages.touchpoints: Email/WhatsApp quote, phone call, free consultation [R: suppliers offer these]
stages.pain: Unknown how Moments and Memories quotes or how fast it replies. Slow or vague replies lose the job. [H]
stages.opportunity: Reply within hours, itemised quote, packages, date-hold offer.

stages.name: 6 Book
stages.label: Confirm and pay a deposit
stages.does: Wants clear terms, a simple way to pay, and confirmation that the date is held.
stages.pain: Process not visible on the site; unclear terms add anxiety. [H]
stages.opportunity: Simple confirmation message, payment link, planning checklist email.

stages.name: 7 Event day
stages.label: Delivery and set-up
stages.does: Needs the supplier on time, equipment safe and the host free to enjoy the day.
stages.pain: Lateness or safety problems are the biggest risk. Suppliers stress safety compliance and public liability insurance. [R]
stages.opportunity: Arrival-window text, tidy set-up, take photos (with permission) for proof.

stages.name: 8 After
stages.label: Review, refer, rebook
stages.does: Posts photos, tells friends, may rebook next year (kids' birthdays repeat). [R: repeat annual clients]
stages.touchpoints: Google review, Facebook, WhatsApp, next-year reminder
stages.pain: No review prompt or referral route on the site; no past-client proof anywhere. [A]
stages.opportunity: Same-day review request, referral credit, rebooking reminder 11 months later.
